items.title: Renewables, Record Natural Gas Output Kept Summer Henry Hub Prices Below $3
items.summary: Increased renewable generation and robust domestic production kept US summer natural gas prices muted despite record heat, but recent supply dips and strong power burns have begun putting upward pressure on spot markets heading into fall.

items.title: October Natural Gas Futures Roll Off Board at $3 as Mountaineer XPress Flows Return
items.summary: October natural gas futures eased Monday as restored Appalachian supply and fading shoulder season demand weighed on the front of the curve.

items.title: US Natural Gas Storage Deficit Poised to Shrink as Autumn Weather Arrives
items.summary: Last week marked not only the start of autumn, but also a return to more autumn-like weather in the Lower 48.

items.title: Global Natural Gas Prices Surge as Diplomacy Fails, LNG Supplies Stay Tight
items.summary: Asian and European natural gas prices were climbing again on Monday as hopes for a quick reopening of the Strait of Hormuz faded.

items.title: Weak Weather Driving Settlement Day Slippage for Natural Gas Futures
items.summary: A bearish weather outlook offset downwardly trending production as natural gas traders squared their positions ahead of the futures contract rollover at today’s close.

items.title: Weekly Natural Gas Spot Prices Slide as Gulf Coast, Eastern Markets Lose Ground
items.summary: Spot natural gas prices in the latest weekly period fell across much of the East, hampered in part by a major pipeline outage that stranded supply and pulled the national average lower.

items.title: Google Data Center Anchors 550,000 Dth/d NGPL Natural Gas Expansion in Texas
items.summary: Natural Gas Pipeline Company of America LLC (NGPL) is asking the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) to approve a 550,000 Dth/d pipeline expansion in the Texas Panhandle that would ship natural gas to power a planned Google data center.

items.title: October Expiry, Easing Demand and Supply Loom Large Over Natural Gas Futures
items.summary: Natural gas futures slumped early Monday as traders took stock of storm fallout, resolution of a major pipeline outage, evolving demand drivers and impending front month contract rollover.

items.title: Appalachia Natural Gas Cash Vaults Off Multi-Year Lows
items.summary: Physical natural gas prices were mixed Monday as Appalachia and Northeast hubs snapped back from Friday’s plunge, while light demand dragged most of the country lower.

items.title: Why Blocking U.S. Diesel Exports Could Make Fuel More Expensive

items.title: High Freight Costs Push More U.S. LNG Toward Europe
items.summary: Europe is currently benefiting from the closed arbitrage between the U.S. Gulf Coast and Asia and is taking more LNG supplies in possible relief from concerns about winter gas supply. The Atlantic-Pacific arbitrage is closed for the rest of this year
